description: Enable noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters in tsconfig and clean the 68 pre-existing violations so dead locals/params are caught at Layer A (typecheck) instead of burning review rounds.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed: noUnusedLocals reports unused locals, noUnusedParameters reports unused params. The leading-underscore escape (e.g. _modelID) exempts PARAMETERS only; locals have no underscore escape and must be genuinely removed. This matches the issue gotchas.

userStories.title: Clean unused locals/params/imports in src/ and scripts/
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the 8 unused-local/param/import violations in production and tooling code removed so the src/scripts surface is clean before the stricter typecheck flags are armed.
acceptanceCriteria: The full flag-on probe reports zero violations under src/ and scripts/. [oracle: bunx tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters 2>&1 | grep -E '^(src/|scripts/)' produces no output]

No new @ts-ignore or @ts-expect-error directive is introduced to suppress an unused local/param; cleanup is real removal or (for required-signature params only) underscore-prefix. [oracle: git diff -- src scripts scripts | grep -E '@ts-(ignore|expect-error)' produces no added lines]
Any unused parameter that is part of a required signature (callback/interface/override) is underscore-prefixed rather than deleted, so behaviour is preserved. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: 8 known violations (all TS6133): scripts/preview-screens.ts:314 'cmd' (local), scripts/test-in-container.ts:103 'failingTests' (local), scripts/ui-snapshot.tsx:18 'ReactElement' (unused import), src/commands/setup.ts:28 'existsSync' (unused import), src/release/merge-watch.ts:945 'logEvent' (local), src/supervisor/host.ts:54 'writeStateFile' (local), src/supervisor/review.ts:35 'PrdSnapshot' (unused import/type), src/tmux/session.ts:441 'sessionName' (param). GOTCHAS from issue spec: (1) if a local's RHS has a side effect, drop only the dead binding, not the expression (e.g. `const x = await setup()` -> `await setup()`); (2) locals must be genuinely removed, renaming to _x does NOT satisfy noUnusedLocals; (3) sessionName is a param at tmux/session.ts:441 - if it is part of a required signature underscore-prefix it (deleting a required param does not fail tsc but silently breaks the contract), otherwise remove. Flags stay OFF in this story (they flip in US-004); verify via the explicit flag-on probe command, not plain typecheck.

userStories.title: Enable noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters in tsconfig.json
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters set to true in the root tsconfig so dead locals/params are caught at gate #1 (typecheck) on every future story, now that all 68 pre-existing violations are cleaned.
acceptanceCriteria: tsconfig.json sets both noUnusedLocals: true and noUnusedParameters: true. [oracle: grep -E '"noUnusedLocals": *true' tsconfig.json && grep -E '"noUnusedParameters": *true' tsconfig.json]
noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature is left false (out of scope). [oracle: grep -E '"noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature": *false' tsconfig.json]
Plain typecheck now catches unused locals/params and exits 0. [oracle: bun run typecheck]
The full 12-gate spine passes green; typecheck rides existing gate #1 and no new gate is added. [oracle: bun run check:all]
knip.json and biome.json are unchanged (no biome noUnusedVariables added). [oracle: git diff --exit-code -- knip.json biome.json]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Single-file config change: tsconfig.json lines 27-28 flip false->true; leave line 29 (noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature) false. This is the gate-arming story and MUST land last: flipping earlier would leave typecheck red while cleanup stories are pending. Per issue scope: do NOT touch knip.json, do NOT configure biome noUnusedVariables (biome.json excludes test/** so it would miss ~88% of violations - tsc is chosen precisely because it covers test/**). No new check:all gate is added, so the gate-count freeze (12) and validate-agents-md are untouched. After this, bun run typecheck and bun run check:all must both be green.
